effect.name: GM Atmospheric Bloom Haze
effect.desc: Wide highlight diffusion combined with depth-like atmospheric veil and horizon-controlled light scatter.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec3 bloom=vec3(0);float ws=0.0;for(int i=0;i<20;i++){float a=float(i)*2.39996323,r=sqrt((float(i)+.5)/20.0)*radiusPx;float w=1.0-float(i)/20.0;vec3 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*r/sz,0.0,1.0)).rgb;float l=max(max(c.r,c.g),c.b);bloom+=c*max(l-threshold,0.0)*w;ws+=w;}bloom=bloom/max(ws,.001)*intensity;float depth=1.0-smoothstep(horizon,1.0,uv.y);vec3 veil=hazeColor.rgb*haze*depth;vec3 result=1.0-(1.0-src.rgb)*(1.0-clamp(bloom+veil,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,result,mixAmount),src.a+clamp(max(max(bloom.r,bloom.g),bloom.b)+haze*depth,0.0,1.0)*mixAmount*(1.0-src.a));}
